title: Implement Sovereign MCP Hub v2.0

title: Scholar Hive Qdrant Vectorization
description: Auto-embed all Scholar Hive documents into Qdrant on create/update for semantic RAG retrieval.

title: RBAC Enforcement for Agent Access
description: Implement role-based access control so agents only access resources matching their permissions.

title: Sprint Planner with Auto-Assignment
description: Build sprint lifecycle management with velocity tracking and round-robin auto-assignment of backlog items to agents.

title: Engine Room UI Integration
description: Wire SentinelTrackPane and ScholarHivePane to the MCP Hub REST API with full CRUD, drag-drop, and modals.

title: MCP Tool Bindings for CORTEX
description: Expose 14 MCP tools via SSE transport so CORTEX can autonomously create issues, manage docs, and run sprints.

title: Docker Deployment for MCP Hub
description: Containerize the MCP Hub and add to docker-compose.genesis.yml for NAS deployment.

title: Audit Log & Compliance Trail
description: Track all mutations with agent identity, timestamp, and change delta for governance compliance.
